name: alignments
description: Sequencing reads mapped to positions in a reference genome, typically in BAM/CRAM format with mapping quality scores and alignment coordinates.

name: alignments with modifications
description: Aligned reads preserving base modification information (e.g., methylation from bisulfite-seq or direct detection) encoded in BAM auxiliary fields.

name: diploid personal genome alignments
description: Reads aligned to a diploid personal genome reference including both parental haplotypes, enabling allele-specific analysis.

name: gene alignments
description: Reads or sequences aligned at the gene level.

name: haplotype-specific alignments
description: Reads confidently assigned and aligned to a specific parental haplotype based on phased variant information.

name: preprocessed alignments
description: Alignments after preprocessing: duplicate marking, base quality score recalibration, or indel realignment.

name: reads
description: Raw or minimally processed sequencing reads in FASTQ format, including quality scores and read identifiers.

name: redacted alignments
description: Alignments with sensitive genomic positions masked or removed for privacy protection in controlled-access data sharing.

name: redacted transcriptome alignments
description: Transcriptome-level alignments with sensitive positions redacted.

name: rejected reads
description: Reads that failed quality control filters and were excluded from downstream analysis.

name: spike-in alignments
description: Reads aligned to exogenous spike-in control sequences (e.g., ERCC) for normalization and quality assessment.

name: transcriptome alignments
description: Reads aligned to a transcriptome reference (cDNA sequences) rather than the genome.

name: base overlap signal
description: Signal computed from base-level read overlap counts at each genomic position.

name: bias-corrected predicted signal profile
description: Model-predicted signal after correction for sequence-composition bias.

name: control normalized signal
description: Signal normalized against a matched control experiment to remove background and technical artifacts.

name: enrichment
description: Quantitative enrichment score over background, measuring signal above expected noise level.

name: fold change over control
description: Signal expressed as the ratio of experimental signal to input/control, highlighting enrichment over background.

name: signal
description: Quantitative signal track showing per-base or per-bin values across the genome, typically in bigWig format.

name: signal p-value
description: Statistical significance track showing -log10(p-value) of enrichment at each position.

name: summed densities signal
description: Signal computed as the sum of per-base read densities across the region.

name: wavelet-smoothed signal
description: Signal smoothed using wavelet transform to reduce noise while preserving peak structure.

name: bidirectional peaks
description: Peaks from bidirectional transcription signal, characteristic of active enhancers and promoters.

name: conservative IDR thresholded peaks
description: Peaks using a conservative (stricter) IDR cutoff, yielding high-confidence but smaller peak set.

name: distal peaks
description: Peaks located distal (>2-3kb) from transcription start sites, often representing enhancers.

name: divergent peaks
description: Peaks from divergent transcription where initiation occurs in both directions from a central point.

name: IDR ranked peaks
description: Peaks ranked by IDR score, with lower IDR indicating higher reproducibility across replicates.

name: optimal IDR thresholded peaks
description: Peaks using the optimal IDR cutoff balancing sensitivity and reproducibility.

name: peaks
description: Discrete genomic regions of statistically significant enrichment from peak calling. The fundamental unit of ChIP-seq and ATAC-seq analysis.

name: peaks and background as input for IDR
description: Combined peak and background signal data formatted as input for IDR analysis.

name: proximal peaks
description: Peaks located proximal (<2-3kb) to transcription start sites, often representing promoters.

name: pseudoreplicated IDR thresholded peaks
description: IDR-thresholded peaks from pseudoreplicates (subsampled reads) when true replicates unavailable.

name: pseudoreplicated peaks
description: Peak calls from pseudoreplicates created by subsampling reads from a single experiment.

name: replicated peaks
description: Peaks reproducibly called across biological or technical replicates.

name: representative DNase hypersensitivity sites
description: A curated representative set of DNase hypersensitivity sites for reference.

name: representative IDR thresholded peaks
description: A representative set of IDR-thresholded peaks selected for downstream analysis.

name: unidirectional peaks
description: Peaks from unidirectional transcription signal, typically associated with gene bodies.

name: valleys
description: Local minima in signal tracks used in footprint detection or nucleosome positioning analysis.

name: consensus DNase hypersensitivity sites
description: DNase I hypersensitivity sites consistently identified across multiple samples or cell types.

name: DHS peaks
description: Peak calls from DNase I hypersensitivity sequencing (DNase-seq), indicating open chromatin regions.

name: DHS regions reference
description: Reference set of DNase I hypersensitivity regions.

name: FDR cut rate
description: False discovery rate-controlled cut rate signal from DNase-seq analysis.

name: haplotype-specific nuclease cleavage corrected frequency
description: Bias-corrected nuclease cleavage frequency for a specific haplotype.

name: haplotype-specific nuclease cleavage frequency
description: Nuclease cleavage frequency measured for a specific haplotype.

name: hotspots
description: Broad regions of elevated DNase cleavage activity representing domains of chromatin accessibility.

name: hotspots1 reference
description: Reference hotspot calls at lenient threshold (hotspot1 algorithm).

name: hotspots2 reference
description: Reference hotspot calls at stringent threshold (hotspot2 algorithm).

name: nuclease cleavage frequency
description: Per-base frequency of DNase I or Tn5 transposase cleavage across the genome.

name: allele-specific contact matrix
description: Chromatin contact matrix resolved to individual alleles using phased variants.

name: contact matrix
description: Genome-wide matrix of chromatin interaction frequencies from Hi-C or similar chromosome conformation capture experiments.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM has topic; lacks contact matrix data type

name: haplotype-specific contact matrix
description: Contact matrix computed separately for a specific parental haplotype.

name: pairs
description: Raw read pair data from Hi-C or proximity ligation before matrix construction.

name: variants contact matrix
description: Contact matrix incorporating variant information.

name: enhancer prediction model
description: Model predicting enhancer activity from sequence or chromatin features.

name: regulatory elements prediction model
description: Computational model for predicting regulatory element activity and location.

name: element barcode mapping
description: Mapping of element barcodes used in CRISPR screen experiments.

name: gRNAs
description: Guide RNA sequences used in CRISPR screens.

name: guide locations
description: Genomic locations targeted by guide RNAs.

name: guide quantifications
description: Abundance quantifications of guide RNAs from screen data.

name: non-targeting gRNAs
description: Guide RNAs designed as non-targeting negative controls.

name: perturbation signal
description: Phenotypic signal associated with CRISPR perturbations.

name: ranked gRNAs
description: Guide RNAs ranked by screen performance or activity.

name: reporter code counts
description: Count data from reporter codes in CRISPR screen readouts.

name: safe-targeting gRNAs
description: Guide RNAs targeting genomic safe-harbor loci as controls.

name: sparse gRNA count matrix
description: Sparse count matrix of guide RNA abundances across cells.

name: fold over change matrix
description: Matrix of fold-change values relative to control across features.

name: sparse gene count matrix
description: Sparse matrix of gene-level read counts across cells or samples, standard for single-cell RNA-seq.

name: sparse peak count matrix
description: Sparse matrix of peak accessibility counts across cells, used in single-cell ATAC-seq.

name: sparse transcript count matrix
description: Sparse matrix of transcript-level counts across cells or samples.

name: TF peaks matrix
description: Matrix of transcription factor peak counts across samples.

name: z scores matrix
description: Matrix of z-score normalized values across features and samples.

name: differential expression quantifications
description: Statistical results from differential expression analysis comparing conditions.

name: differential splicing quantifications
description: Statistical results from differential splicing analysis comparing conditions.

name: element quantifications
description: Quantification values for regulatory elements.

name: exon quantifications
description: Read counts or expression values quantified at individual exons.

name: gene quantifications
description: Expression quantifications at gene level as read counts, TPM, or FPKM values.

name: gene stabilities
description: Measurements of mRNA or gene expression stability over time.

name: genic features quantifications
description: Quantifications across various genic features (exons, introns, UTRs).

name: genic regions quantifications
description: Read count quantifications over defined genic regions.

name: merged transcription segment quantifications
description: Quantifications from merged transcription segments.

name: microRNA quantifications
description: Expression quantifications of microRNAs (miRNAs).

name: mRNA stabilities
description: Measurements of mRNA half-life or decay rates.

name: novel peptides
description: Peptides identified that are absent from reference databases.

name: peptide quantifications
description: Abundance measurements of peptides from mass spectrometry proteomics.

name: protein expression quantifications
description: Abundance measurements of proteins from proteomics data.

name: scaled RNA stability
description: RNA stability measurements scaled across samples.

name: transcript quantifications
description: Expression quantifications at transcript isoform level.

name: transcribed region quantifications
description: Quantifications over transcribed genomic regions.

name: transcription segment quantifications
description: Quantifications over discrete transcription segments.

name: UV enriched segment quantifications
description: Quantifications from UV-crosslinking enriched RNA segments.

name: bias models
description: Trained models capturing sequencing bias patterns based on sequence composition.

name: counts sequence contribution scores
description: Per-nucleotide importance scores explaining sequence contribution to predicted counts (e.g., DeepLIFT, integrated gradients).

name: DNN-MPRA contribution scores
description: Nucleotide contribution scores from a deep neural network trained on MPRA data.

name: DNN-MPRA predicted signal
description: Regulatory activity signal predicted by a DNN trained on MPRA data.

name: model performance metrics
description: Evaluation metrics (AUC, correlation, etc.) assessing predictive model performance.

name: models
description: Trained computational or machine learning models saved for prediction or interpretation.

name: motif model
description: Sequence motif model (e.g., convolutional filter weights) from deep learning or motif discovery.

name: profile sequence contribution scores
description: Per-nucleotide importance scores explaining sequence contribution to predicted signal profiles.

name: promoter prediction model
description: Computational model trained to predict promoter activity from sequence.

name: selected regions for bias-corrected predicted signal profile
description: Genomic regions selected for bias-corrected signal profile interpretation.

name: selected regions for count sequence contribution scores
description: Genomic regions selected for count contribution score analysis.

name: selected regions for predicted bias profile
description: Genomic regions selected for predicted bias profile interpretation.

name: selected regions for predicted signal and sequence contribution scores
description: Genomic regions selected for combined signal and contribution score analysis.

name: selected regions for predicted signal profile
description: Genomic regions selected for predicted signal profile interpretation.

name: selected regions for profile sequence contribution scores
description: Genomic regions selected for profile contribution score analysis.

name: TF binding prediction model
description: Deep learning model predicting transcription factor binding from DNA sequence.

name: training and test regions
description: Genomic regions designated for model training and held-out evaluation.

name: training set
description: Data used to train a computational or machine learning model.

name: fine-mapped variants
description: Variants identified as likely causal through statistical fine-mapping within associated loci.

name: variant functional prediction
description: Computational predictions of variant functional impact.

name: chromosome sizes
description: File listing chromosome/contig names and lengths, required by many genomics tools.

name: chromosomes reference
description: Reference sequences for individual chromosomes.

name: elements reference
description: Reference set of annotated genomic elements.

name: genome index
description: Precomputed index enabling rapid sequence alignment to a reference genome.

name: genome reference
description: Reference genome sequence assembly used for alignment and annotation.

name: miRNA reference
description: Reference sequences and annotations for microRNAs.

name: mitochondrial genome index
description: Alignment index for the mitochondrial genome.

name: mitochondrial genome reference
description: Reference sequence for the mitochondrial genome.

name: motif clusters reference
description: Reference set of clustered sequence motifs.

name: phastcons score reference
description: Reference phastCons conservation scores across the genome.

name: reference
description: Generic reference data file.

name: repeats reference
description: Reference annotations of repetitive elements.

name: rRNA reference
description: Reference sequences for ribosomal RNA.

name: snRNA reference
description: Reference sequences for small nuclear RNA.

name: transcriptome index
description: Index for rapid alignment to transcriptome reference sequences.

name: transcriptome reference
description: Reference transcript sequences for a species, used for RNA-seq alignment.

name: tRNA reference
description: Reference sequences for transfer RNA.

name: HMM predicted chromatin state
description: Chromatin state annotations (e.g., ChromHMM) predicted by hidden Markov model from histone marks.

name: read annotations
description: Per-read annotations of alignment features or classifications.

name: semi-automated genome annotation
description: Genome annotation produced by a combination of automated and manual methods.

name: sequence alignability
description: Track indicating mappability of sequences to the reference genome.

name: sequence uniqueness
description: Track indicating uniqueness of k-mer sequences across the genome.

name: archr project
description: ArchR software project file with processed single-cell ATAC-seq data and analyses.

name: cell coordinates
description: Low-dimensional coordinates (UMAP, t-SNE, PCA) for single-cell visualization.

name: cell topic participation
description: Cell-level participation scores in latent topics from topic modeling.

name: clusters
description: Cell cluster assignments from unsupervised clustering of single-cell data.

name: capture targets
description: Genomic regions targeted for enrichment in capture-based sequencing (exome, panels).

name: exclusion list regions
description: Genomic blacklist regions excluded due to mapping artifacts or technical issues.

name: filtered regions
description: Genomic regions removed from analysis after filtering.

name: fragments
description: DNA or RNA fragment data prior to alignment.

name: idat green channel
description: Green channel intensity data from Illumina IDAT microarray files.

name: idat red channel
description: Red channel intensity data from Illumina IDAT microarray files.

name: inclusion list
description: Allowlist of genomic regions or barcodes included in analysis.

name: index reads
description: Index read sequences for sample demultiplexing.

name: intensity values
description: Raw intensity measurements from microarray or imaging experiments.

name: kmer weights
description: Frequency or weight values for k-mer sequences.

name: library fraction
description: Proportion of sequencing library represented by a sample or subset.

name: mitochondrial exclusion list regions
description: Mitochondrial regions excluded from nuclear genome analysis.

name: nanopore signal
description: Raw ionic current signal from nanopore sequencing.

name: negative control regions
description: Genomic regions used as negative controls in experiments.

name: positive control regions
description: Genomic regions used as positive controls in experiments.

name: primer sequence
description: Oligonucleotide primer sequences used in PCR or sequencing.

name: R2C2 subreads
description: Rolling circle amplification sub-reads from R2C2 long-read sequencing.

name: raw data
description: Unprocessed experimental data in original format before computational processing.

name: raw imaging signal
description: Unprocessed signal from imaging-based experiments.

name: sequence adapters
description: Adapter sequences ligated to library fragments for sequencing platform compatibility.

name: sequence barcodes
description: Short DNA sequences labeling samples (multiplexing) or individual cells (single-cell).

name: spike-ins
description: Exogenous sequences of known concentration added for normalization (e.g., ERCC RNA spike-ins).

name: subreads
description: Sub-read data from long-read sequencing platforms (PacBio).

name: validation
description: Data generated for experimental validation purposes.

name: end position signal
description: Signal of read end positions.

name: modified peptide quantification
description: Quantification of post-translationally modified peptides.

name: sparse splice junction count matrix
description: Sparse count matrix of splice junctions.

name: signals matrix
description: Matrix of signal values across features and samples.

name: signal profile
description: Signal profile across genomic positions.

name: bias profile
description: Sequencing bias profile across genomic positions.

name: control profile
description: Control signal profile.

name: footprints
description: Short protected regions within open chromatin indicating transcription factor occupancy, identified as local signal minima within peaks.

name: open chromatin regions
description: Genomic regions of accessible chromatin from ATAC-seq, DNase-seq, or similar assays.

name: chromatin stripes
description: Elongated features in contact matrices extending from loop anchors, indicating active loop extrusion.

name: contact domains
description: Topologically associating domains (TADs) from contact matrix analysis, representing self-interacting chromatin regions.

name: genome compartments
description: Large-scale A (active) and B (inactive) chromatin compartments from PCA of Hi-C contact matrices.

name: genome subcompartments
description: Fine-grained chromatin compartments (A1, A2, B1, B2, B3, B4) within major A/B compartments.

name: loops
description: Chromatin loop interactions (point-to-point contacts) from contact matrices, often connecting enhancers to promoters.

name: nested contact domains
description: Hierarchically nested topological domains showing multi-scale chromatin organization.

name: CpG sites coverage
description: Sequencing read coverage at CpG positions, indicating measurement confidence.

name: methylated reads
description: Reads containing DNA methylation marks from bisulfite or direct detection methods.

name: methylation state at CHG
description: DNA methylation status at CHG sequence context (H = A, C, or T), common in plant genomes.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM has topic; lacks CHG methylation data type

name: methylation state at CHH
description: DNA methylation status at CHH sequence context, representing asymmetric non-CpG methylation.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM has topic; lacks CHH methylation data type

name: methylation state at CpG
description: DNA methylation status (methylated/unmethylated fraction) at CpG dinucleotides, the primary context for mammalian methylation.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM has topic; lacks CpG methylation data type

name: smoothed methylation state at CpG
description: CpG methylation values smoothed across neighboring sites to reduce noise.

name: candidate Cis-Regulatory Elements
description: Computationally predicted cis-regulatory elements (CREs) including enhancers, promoters, and insulators from chromatin accessibility and histone data.

name: candidate enhancers
description: Computationally predicted enhancer elements based on chromatin signatures (H3K4me1, H3K27ac, accessibility).

name: candidate promoters
description: Computationally predicted promoter elements based on chromatin signatures and TSS proximity.

name: curated binding sites
description: Manually curated and validated transcription factor binding sites.

name: enhancer validation
description: Experimental validation data for predicted enhancers.

name: enhancers reference
description: Reference set of annotated enhancer elements.

name: polyA sites
description: Polyadenylation signal sites where pre-mRNA is cleaved and polyadenylated.

name: predicted enhancers
description: Computationally predicted enhancer elements.

name: promoters reference
description: Reference set of annotated promoter elements.

name: regulatory elements
description: General annotation of regulatory elements: enhancers, promoters, silencers, and insulators.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM lacks regulatory element data type

name: transcription start sites
description: Experimentally determined transcription start sites (TSS) from CAGE, PRO-seq, or similar assays.

name: TSS reference
description: Reference set of transcription start sites.

name: element gene interactions p-value
description: Statistical significance of element-gene interaction associations.

name: element gene interactions signal
description: Signal strength of element-gene interaction associations.

name: element gene links
description: Associations linking regulatory elements (commonly enhancers) to their putative target genes.

name: topic gene weights
description: Gene weights derived from topic modeling of regulatory data.

name: relative replication signal
description: Replication timing signal expressed relative to a reference.

name: replication timing profile
description: Genome-wide profile of DNA replication timing.

name: allele-specific variants
description: Variants showing allele-specific behavior in expression or chromatin accessibility.

name: copy number variation
description: Genomic regions with altered copy numbers (deletions, duplications) relative to reference.

name: curated SNVs
description: Manually curated and validated single nucleotide variants.

name: dsQTLs
description: DNase I sensitivity quantitative trait loci: variants associated with chromatin accessibility.

name: eQTLs
description: Expression quantitative trait loci: variants statistically associated with gene expression levels.

name: maternal variant calls
description: Variants called specifically from the maternal haplotype.

name: paternal variant calls
description: Variants called specifically from the paternal haplotype.

name: phased variant calls
description: Variants with haplotype phase resolved, indicating which alleles co-occur on the same chromosome.

name: reference variants
description: Variants relative to a reference genome.

name: variant calls
description: Called genomic variants (SNPs, indels, structural variants) in VCF format.

name: variant effect quantifications
description: Quantitative measurements of variant functional effects.

name: variant reference
description: Reference database or set of known genomic variants.

name: PWMs
description: Position weight matrices representing sequence motif models, encoding nucleotide preferences at each position.

name: sequence motifs
description: Sequence patterns enriched in genomic regions of interest.

name: sequence motifs instances
description: Genomic locations where specific sequence motifs occur.

name: sequence motifs report
description: Summary report of motif discovery or enrichment analysis.

name: functional conservation mapping
description: Mapping of functionally conserved regions across species.

name: functional conservation quantifications
description: Quantification of functional conservation scores.

name: miRNA annotations
description: Annotation tracks for microRNA genes and precursors.

name: repeat elements annotation
description: Annotation of repetitive element locations and classes.

name: restriction enzyme site locations
description: Genomic positions of restriction enzyme recognition sites.

name: RNA-binding protein associated mRNAs
description: mRNAs co-immunoprecipitated with RNA-binding proteins.

name: splice junctions
description: Splice site junctions identified from RNA-seq alignments.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM has topic only; no splice junction data type

name: transcribed fragments
description: Genomic regions identified as transcribed from RNA-seq data.

name: transcriptome annotations
description: Comprehensive gene and transcript annotations for a genome.

name: transposable element TF ancestral origin percent by motif
description: Percentage of TF motif instances with transposable element ancestral origin.

name: transposable element TF ancestral origin percent by subfamily
description: Percentage of TF binding sites by TE subfamily ancestral origin.

name: cell type annotations
description: Cell type labels assigned to individual cells based on marker genes or reference mapping.

name: cell type data
description: Data associated with cell type identity in single-cell experiments.

name: 3D structure
description: Three-dimensional structural model of a genomic region or chromatin domain.

name: contigs
description: Assembled sequence contigs from genome assembly.

name: personalized genome assembly
description: Genome assembly incorporating an individual's sequence variation.

name: predicted 3D structural ensembles
description: Computationally predicted ensembles of 3D genomic structures.

name: maternal haplotype mapping
description: Sequence reads or contigs assigned to the maternal haplotype.

name: paternal haplotype mapping
description: Sequence reads or contigs assigned to the paternal haplotype.

name: phased mapping
description: Sequence data with haplotype phase information resolved.

name: Nm methylation state
description: 2′-O-methylation (Nm) modification.

name: SNPs
description: Single nucleotide polymorphisms.

name: indels
description: Insertion/deletion variants.

name: inosine methylation state
description: Inosine (A-to-I editing) modification.

name: m5C methylation state
description: 5-methylcytosine (m5C) RNA modification.

name: m6A methylation state
description: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modification on transcripts. m6A is the most abundant internal mRNA modification.

name: pseudouridine methylation state
description: Pseudouridine (Ψ) modification. Pseudouridine is the most abundant RNA modification.

name: links
description: Generic regulatory links associating genomic elements with target features.
